QuestInfo.name: [Lethe] Persistent Pooches
QuestInfo.0: For some reason, #p3007113# says the wolves need a moment to discuss among themselves. You've given them a reasonable amount of time, so see what they have to say.
QuestInfo.1: You defeated the Mushmom. Talk to #p3007113# to bring the wolves back under your command.
QuestInfo.2: The wolves insisted you defeat the Mushmom, so you did so with ease before reclaiming your vassals.
